abort.single_instance_allowed: Hearth is already set up. Add rooms from its Configure button.

user.title: Hearth
user.description: Hearth runs every room's heating the same way, whatever heats it. Choose the switch that calls your boiler for heat for the radiators: Hearth turns it on while a room wants heat and off when none does. You can choose it later in the Hearth panel too. Add rooms from Hearth in the sidebar.

data_description.boiler_switch: Any on/off switch: a boiler relay, a thermostat's call-for-heat switch, or a helper.

abort.use_panel: Rooms and house settings are in the Hearth panel: open Hearth in the sidebar.

set_schedule.name: Set schedule
set_schedule.description: Set a room's weekday and weekend schedule. Each day is a list of changes, up to six, each a time and a temperature, like time 06:30, temp 19.

boost.name: Boost
boost.description: Warm a room up for a while, then go back to what it was doing.

minutes.name: Minutes
minutes.description: How long. Defaults to the house setting.
